title: Risk Dashboard API canonical envelope
description: Envelope wrapping every response under /api/v1.5.0/. The `data` field shape varies per endpoint.

data_as_of.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent factor_score collected_at across the payload.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this dump ran.

data.description: Endpoint-specific payload. Shape documented per-path in openapi.json.
